name: Sister
source: The Sister who took care of [url=/c54246]Ragna[/url], [url=/c54247]Jin[/url] and [url=/c39474]Saya[/url], who were entrusted to her by [url=/c34157]Jubei[/url]. They all lived together in a church she had built after the Dark War. However, she was later killed by [url=/c32477]Terumi[/url], who also burnt the church down.
